answer: Require every agent identity to emit a periodic pulse: a small proof of recent useful work, signed and anchored to a stake locked in a bridge contract. The pulse is cheap for one real agent but must be produced separately for each identity, so a sybil farm pays continuous compute and locked capital per fake. Missed pulses decay reputation and trigger stake slashing, like a pearl that loses lustre without care. One-time creation is free; staying alive costs, and that recurring cost is what makes mass fakery uneconomic.
